newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine plans '97 municipal Eurobond issue - c.bank.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine plans '97 municipal Eurobond issue - c.bank.

text.p: Ukrainian cities are preparing debut issues of Eurobonds next year with central bank help, bank chairman Viktor Yushchenko said.
Yushchenko said he had sought the help of two large international banks in the project.
"We are preparing to issue them on the world market next year," he said.
Yushchenko said larger Ukrainian cities would issue the new bonds, but provided no further details.
Ukraine is also planning to launch its own Eurobonds in the first quarter of 1997 and is currently in discussions with Western banks, Yushchenko added. --Yuri Kulikov, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
